notes: Nill Download Manager 2.2.0 closes the remaining measured gaps against IDM-class download managers: cookie-gated sites now download (session cookies are kept), trickling connections are detected and replaced instead of stalling a download forever, one throttled response no longer slows the whole pool, starts take fewer round trips and resume checks run in parallel, downloads survive a server dropping range support mid-download, and FTP downloads are supported with resume where the server allows. Video information loads instantly on repeat lookups, and the pre-Windows-10 video path no longer depends on components those systems may not run. A program such as an antivirus scanner can run automatically when a download completes; the scheduler gains day-of-week, one-time and synchronize modes; categories can match by site; the grabber can rewrite links for offline browsing and run on a schedule; the extension's force/bypass hold-keys are configurable; finished files can be dragged out of the list; and Windows gets a single universal installer that installs the right build for the machine, 64-bit or 32-bit.
